school_name: La Petite Academy on Beach Blvd.
welcome_text: Welcome to Our School Welcome to La Petite Academy on Beach Boulevard in Jacksonville, Florida! Since 1991, we have provided quality daycare and early education in a safe, supportive environment. Our school is accredited by the National Early Childhood Program Accreditation (NECPA) and holds Gold Seal Quality Care status with the State of Florida. We are conveniently located on Beach Boulevard between Hodges Boulevard and San Pablo Road, across from Denny's. Our programs include Infants, Toddlers, Twos, Preschool, Pre-K, and Summer Camp. We also provide before- and after-school care for students attending Alimacani and Chets Creek elementary schools. Our teachers are enthusiastic early childhood education professionals who stay current with monthly training sessions and ongoing training offered by the state. Additionally, all teachers and management staff are certified in CPR and First Aid. We are proud to boast that we have a combined 100 years of early childhood education experience! We're committed to keeping you connected throughout the day while your child is in our care. Get access to live streaming video of your child's classroom, plus other real-time updates, with our exclusive mobile app for families, SproutAbout. We are confident La Petite Academy offers the best education-driven child care in Jacksonville, FL. Schedule a tour today, we can't wait to meet your family!

Daycare and Early Education Programs Infants 6 weeks - 1 year We've created a comfortable, secure space for your baby to thrive and grow. Toddlers 1 - 2 years old This age group has all the space they need to move, explore, and grow through hands-on learning. Twos 2 - 2.5 years old This energetic group is always on the move as they achieve new abilities and experiences. Preschool 3 - 4 years old Active little innovators use hands-on learning experiences to get ready for kindergarten. Pre-K 4 - 5 years old As they further build a foundation for kindergarten, children lay the groundwork for high-level skill development. Before & After School 5 – 12 years old Fun, exciting, educational mornings and afternoons await your school-age student. Summer Camp Our full-day program is full of adventures, hands-on activities, outdoor playtime, and more. Here's what people have to say Give Your Child a Great Start With VPK Voluntary Pre-Kindergarten (VPK) is a free daily, 4-hour program that includes breakfast and lunch, with the option of extended wrap care. This full-day learning experience enhances your child's school readiness journey. Every child who turns 4 by September 1 may be eligible for free VPK. Schedule a tour to learn more. Open a window to your child's day. SproutAbout ® , our exclusive family app, provides free live streaming video of your child's classroom to your mobile device. Proudly Accredited by NECPA Our school is accredited by the National Early Childhood Program Accreditation , a nationally recognized organization that sets rigorous standards for excellence in early childhood education. This accreditation reflects our commitment to providing high-quality child care and early education in a safe, nurturing environment where children can learn, grow, and thrive every day. Learn About Electives For an additional fee, go beyond regular classroom learning experiences with our enhanced series of fun, interactive enrichment programs exploring a variety of activities. We offer: Gymnastics, Handwriting & Advanced Math, Music, Phonics, Soccer, Spanish, Yoga Meet Our Staff Dee Pryor, Director Certifications : CDA, Directors Credential I have more than 20 years of experience in early childhood education and take pride in my position as director. I have a passion for early childhood education and love seeing smiles on the children's faces when they learn something new. Frequently Asked Questions Tuition varies based on your child's program and schedule. Our team is happy to answer your questions, share current tuition rates, and help you find the right option for your family. Yes, child care assistance and subsidy programs may be available to help eligible families with the cost of care. Our team is happy to answer your questions, share information about the programs we accept, and help you understand the process. Part-time enrollment and flexible care options may be available based on your child's program and current availability. Our team is happy to help you explore scheduling options that work for your family. Contact us to learn more about part-time or drop-in care. Each day at La Petite Academy is filled with opportunities for your child to learn, play, explore, and grow. Children explore learning centers, participate in small- and large-group activities, spend time outdoors, and enjoy plenty of opportunities for choice and play. Meals, snacks, and rest are also built into the day, creating a familiar routine that helps children feel comfortable while keeping each day fun and engaging. Daily activities are designed with your child's age and developmental stage in mind. Our teachers regularly observe your child's development and use those insights to plan learning experiences that support their individual needs and growth. Each child has an individual portfolio that grows with them as they move from one age group to the next, capturing their learning, milestones, and accomplishments along the way. Teachers use developmental checklists, work samples, photos, and observations to understand how your child is progressing and identify opportunities to build new skills. Families stay connected every step of the way through SproutAbout updates, family-teacher conferences, and daily conversations with their child's teachers. Moving to a new classroom is an exciting milestone. Children gradually visit their new classroom, meet their teachers, and become familiar with new routines before the transition. Teachers work together to support continuity, while families receive regular updates throughout the process.
